questions.why: Counting from the bottom, the sixth finger is your right middle finger.

questions.text: If you hopped up this hopscotch, landing on only the numbers in red and green spaces, then turned around and hopped back down landing on only the odd numbers, in which direction would the numbers add up to a higher total?
questions.why: Going up, you'd hop on 1 + 3 + 4 + 7 + 10 = 25. On the way back, you'd hop on 9 + 7 + 5 + 3 + 1 = 25.

questions.text: These knights each carry a flag bearing their family name and the territory they rule over. However, one is an impostor. Which knight doesn't belong?
questions.why: Three of the names contain the direction of that knight's territory - NORTH (UP), EAST (RIGHT), SOUTH (DOWN). However, BENNET does not contain a direction.

questions.text: In what year would a person born in 1990 turn the age that is the sum of the digits in the number 1990?
questions.why: 1+9+9+0 = 19. A person born in 1990 would have had their 19th birthday in 2009.

questions.text: Mary runs twice as fast as Pat. They are running a three-lap race, starting and finishing at the marked line and running counterclockwise around the track. Mary is half a lap away from finishing. Approximately where on the track is Pat? (Type the letter)
questions.why: Mary has run 2 and 1/2 laps and runs twice as fast as Pat. (5/2 /2 = 5/4) so Pat has run 1 and 1/4 laps, which will put him at point B.
